# NEXUS CORE

> Free AI-built gold (XAUUSD) game plan: key zones, scenarios and the level that proves the view wrong — refreshed before the Asia, London and New York sessions, every plan graded in public.

NEXUS CORE AI publishes a free, AI-built trading plan for gold (XAUUSD) three times each trading day: before the Asia session (07:00 GMT+7), before London (13:45 GMT+7) and before New York (19:30 GMT+7). Each plan gives the bias, the main zone, targets, the level that invalidates the view, scenarios with rough probabilities, and the economic calendar. Every plan is graded in public on 15-minute candles after it expires — wins, losses and misses all stay on the record. Analysis only, not financial advice.

## Latest plan (2026-11-12, Asia plan, updated 2026-11-12 07:31 GMT+7)

- Permanent page: https://nexuscore.trade/en/plan/2026-11-12-asia/
- Bias: TWO-WAY · leaning SELL
- Summary: Two-way, leaning SELL on rallies into 4035.4–4046.5; void on M15 close above 4049
- Main zone: SELL 4035.4–4046.5
- Target T1: 3957.7
- Target T2: 3932.6
- Target T3: 3920.8
- Expected range: 3920.8–4049
- View is wrong if: M15 close above 4049 → main zone fails, next resistance 4050.5–4060; H4 close above 4068 → sell side off, upper range edge 4100.
- Main scenario (~50%, SELL): Bounce into 3987–3995.4 or 4018.7–4031.4 (at most 4035.4–4046.5) gets rejected, then down to 3957.7; a break opens 3932.6.
- Alternate scenario (~30%, SELL): Straight drop with an M15 close below 3957.7 → 3932.6–3920.8.
- Alternate scenario (~20%, BUY): M15 close above 3999.9 → stronger bounce to 4018.7–4031.4, possibly 4035.4–4046.5.
